ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
